name: What is trim and molding?
description: Trim and molding are decorative and functional elements that finish interior spaces, covering seams and protecting walls.

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim and molding refers to the decorative and functional elements that finish the interior of a home, covering seams and transitions between surfaces. This includes baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings, and chair rails. Beyond aesthetics, trim protects walls from damage and can conceal imperfections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim and molding are decorative and functional elements that finish interior spaces, covering seams and protecting walls.
